## What changed

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Python tests and schema validation pass.
- [ ] Reviewer typecheck/tests/build pass when UI or packaging changes.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests or a documented manual check.
- [ ] Public report/review/waiver/Action compatibility was preserved or explicitly versioned.

## Privacy, security, and provenance

- [ ] No confidential policy text, reviewer notes, credentials, local absolute paths, or telemetry were added.
- [ ] New corpus material has source, date, hashes, attribution, and a redistribution decision.
- [ ] Generated and release artifacts contain no deployment metadata or development dependencies.

## Screenshots

Attach before/after images only when presentation changed, using synthetic data.
